title: [DEV-04] Scaffold Next.js (App Router) into the existing repo
body:
**Owner:** DEV-04

**Goal:** Add Next.js, React, Tailwind and next-intl on top of 
the existing structure without moving or deleting anything.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- 
`src/app/[locale]/...` routes exist with en and fr
- Existing `npm run lint`, `typecheck`, `test` 
still pass
- CI also runs `next build`
- No file under `src/game/` is modified

Read 
`AGENTS.md`, `CONVENTIONS.md` and `interfaces.md` first. Work only inside your owned paths (see 
`.github/CODEOWNERS`).

title: [DEV-04] Supabase project, migrations and RLS
body:
**Owner:** DEV-04

**Goal:** Create tables characters, action_log, transactions, 
world_state with row-level security.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- Migrations are reversible and 
live in `supabase/migrations/`
- `action_log` has UNIQUE (player_id, key)
- RLS: a player can 
read only their own character; no client writes to money or energy
- Types generated into 
`src/lib/database.types.ts`

Read `AGENTS.md`, `CONVENTIONS.md` and `interfaces.md` first. Work 
only inside your owned paths (see `.github/CODEOWNERS`).

body:

title: [DEV-01] Server action handler: lock, reduce, persist
body:
**Owner:** DEV-01

**Goal:** Implement `src/server/handle-action.ts`: load player 
FOR UPDATE, call `applyAction`, persist state and action_log in one transaction.

**Acceptance 
criteria:**
- Repeating the same idempotency key returns the stored result and changes nothing
- 
Concurrent actions on one player serialize correctly (test with parallel calls)
- Failures return 
the error code from `ErrorCode` unchanged

Read `AGENTS.md`, `CONVENTIONS.md` and `interfaces.md` 
first. Work only inside your owned paths (see `.github/CODEOWNERS`).
